name: animated-grid-pattern
title: Animated Grid Pattern
description: A line grid on which random cells softly light up and fade out, each coming back at a new spot: the familiar tech backdrop.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.animatedGridPattern(q(".mw-animated-grid-pattern"), tl, 0, { width: 64, height: 64, numSquares: 40, maxOpacity: 1, duration: 2, repeatDelay: 0.6, color: "rgba(156,163,175,0.35)", hold: 8 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: One square's cycle: delay i x 0.1 s, fade in `duration`, hold repeatDelay, fade out `duration`, then a new cell. Upstream demo: 30 squares, maxOpacity 0.1, duration 3, repeatDelay 1, radial mask, skewY(12deg).
moworks.titleVi: Lưới kẻ có ô sáng lên tắt dần
